feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated. The best raced design is iteration 2 (score 625.2): the oval finished 20 of 20 at a mean of 1.95 s, the s-bend finished 17 of 20 with steering_oscillation 0.42, and the slalom went off_track on every trial with progress 0.17, max_error about 0.0615 m and one line-loss event per run. This candidate changes one field, kp from 1.4 to 1.6, and keeps kd 0.4, base_speed 1.0, line_loss 'last_direction' and the iteration 2 geometry. Any change in result therefore comes from kp. The slalom failure is an early drift at low jitter (0.15), and iteration 1 (kp 1.2) and iteration 2 (kp 1.4) both stopped it near 17% progress, so a stronger correction is the right direction. The main risk is the s-bend, which already oscillates at 0.42 (above the 0.15 threshold), and a higher kp may push that further. Approve it: it is a single-step change from the best design, it is valid, and the race will show whether kp is the limit on the slalom. After the race, read the result as follows. If the slalom still ends off_track with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.15 and progress is still low, raise kp toward 1.8 with kd held at 0.4. If the s-bend oscillation rises above about 0.5 while the robot stays on the line, raise kd toward 0.5 with kp held at 1.6, since kd is the damping term that is missing. If the oval completion_time rises above about 2.5 s or the oval fails, base_speed is too low and should move toward 1.1 to 1.2.
requested_changes: If the slalom still ends off_track at low steering_oscillation (at or below about 0.15), raise kp from 1.6 toward 1.8 and keep kd at 0.4, because kp 1.2 and kp 1.4 both stopped the slalom at about 17% progress with max_error near 0.06 m.

If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.5 (iteration 2 measured 0.42) while the robot stays on the line, raise kd from 0.4 to about 0.5 with kp held at 1.6, to damp the turn command without removing the steering gain.

If the oval completion_time rises above about 2.5 s or the oval stops finishing, raise base_speed from 1.0 toward 1.1 to 1.2, keeping kp and kd fixed, since base_speed 1.2 gave 1.88 s and base_speed 1.0 gave 1.95 s on the oval.
